title: Data Processing Agreement: The 8 Terms GDPR Requires
meta_description: A data processing agreement is the GDPR Article 28 contract with any vendor that handles personal data on your behalf. It must cover 8 duties, in writing.
secondary_keywords: does a dpa need to be signed

image.takeaway: Article 28(3) lists 8 duties for every processor contract; Article 28(9) requires writing, electronic allowed.
image.alt: Hero card for an article on the GDPR data processing agreement: the eight duties Article 28(3) requires, the writing rule, and who in a cold email stack needs one.
